title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
original_title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
plot_overview: A comedian spends 28 days eating fried chicken while traveling across the UK and US. The experiment explores the effects of a powerful craving and investigates the industry behind one of fast food’s most popular meals.
will_you_like_this: You’ll enjoy this if you like provocative food investigations and socially minded documentaries; Not for you if you dislike diet experiments, fast-food debates, or confrontational nonfiction.
review_summary: Pros: bold premise; built-in curiosity; cross-country scope | Cons: limited review context; potentially repetitive subject; diet may be divisive
